figurative_meaning_en: to slap on top of a slap (to give additional or repeated punishment)
example_sentences_in_bangla: তোমার ভুলের জন্য একটা থাবড়া, আরও যদি করো তাহলে আরও থাবড়ানো হবে।
example_sentences_in_english: If you talk too much, I'll slap you.
For your mistake, one slap, and if you do more, you'll get slapped on top of that.
note: This idiom uses physical action metaphorically to emphasize escalation in reprimand, common in everyday Bengali dialogue.
